narrative.weekly_mirror: This week held a contrast between helping Amira debug the nonprofit intake form—“the right use of a Tuesday evening”—and two moments where your choices felt further from making the world a fairer, better place: “I sat there and said nothing” and “I picked convenience and cost.”
narrative.tension_explanation: The tension seems to sit between a concrete act of support and later moments of silence and choosing what was easiest or least costly. What those situations involved, and what made speaking or choosing differently difficult, remains open.
narrative.reflective_question: When you look at these three moments together, what feels most important to understand about the gap between helping Amira and the times you “said nothing” or “picked convenience and cost”?.
